providers.title: Medtronic partners with Apollo Hospitals to launch advanced ‘ICU of the Future’ in Hyderabad
providers.summary: The 11-bed advanced ICU will integrate Medtronic's Acute Care & Monitoring technologies to enhance critical care delivery, support clinical decision-making, and improve patient outcomes through technology-enabled intensive care.

providers.summary: The hospital chain said this marks its strategic entry into Madhya Pradesh, as it looks to further strengthen its presence across Western and Central India.

providers.title: 16 Ayushman hospitals face action in Bijnor over lapses
providers.summary: The action came after a three-member inspection team conducted unannounced visits to 20 empanelled hospitals in the district to assess compliance with the scheme’s operational guidelines, Standard Treatment Guidelines (STGs) and prescribed quality norms.
